focus: internal relational integrity, data-class provenance and browser mutation surface

live_audit.classification: synthetic fixture TEST-P9-ALLOCATION; must remain excluded from production authority

p0_findings: Wholesale portal order creation inherits deals.data_class default=demo because data_class is not explicit.
copy_deal does not preserve data_class and therefore creates copied orders as demo.
convert_reorder_to_deal does not propagate source/proposal data_class and therefore creates converted reorders as demo.
mp_client_snapshot does not restrict orders to data_class=production.
mp_client_issued_proformas does not restrict proformas to production deals.
copy_deal and capture_deal_revision are raw public primitives executable by anon/authenticated and should not be browser APIs.
Frontend live bootstrap used UI roles private/wholesale where live DB RPCs require private_client/buyer.
Public-schema default ACLs for both postgres and supabase_admin automatically grant future objects to anon/authenticated; target revokes these defaults for both creator roles.
already_green: Tenant/client/store/product/shipment/fit relational audit has zero observed scope mismatches.
payments_external_ref_uq prevents duplicate payment references per tenant.
target_invariants: Browser-created wholesale orders are explicitly production.
Deal copy preserves source data_class; buyer copy is allowed only for production source deals.
Sell-through data_class provenance is propagated batch -> reorder proposal -> converted deal with safe demo fallback.
All client snapshots/proformas hide demo and synthetic deals.
All browser mutation wrappers reject non-production deals.
Raw copy_deal and capture_deal_revision are not executable by anon/authenticated.
Future public objects do not gain browser grants by default.
Browser RPC authorization arguments come from mp_my_access memberships[].db_role, never UI role labels.
Default privileges for postgres and supabase_admin do not automatically expose future public tables, sequences or functions to browser roles.
